https://www.gog.com/game/heroes_of_science_and_fiction_xenauri_faction

Following the lead of the mysterious prophet from the desert known as the Pathfinder, the Xenauri cross the vast expanse of deep space and find their way to the Siren System. How do the factions of the system respond to the violent newcomers? You'll discover the answer - and much more - across two narrative-focused levels, seen through the eyes of a young Xenauri commander leading her fighters through the invasion's aftermath.
